 "body": "<!-- mipstarre-issue-key: qpbt-stage43-magic-square-rigidity -->
### Motivation

Discharge the external Magic Square self-testing boundary used by QPBT
soundness. The canonical project statement is `thm:ms-rigidity` in
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`,
matched by `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. The cited
external source is Coladangelo--Stark, arXiv:1709.09267v2, Theorem 6.9.

The cited external proof obtains this as a robust linear-constraint-system
self-test using its general solution-group/stability machinery. This repository
has no such general framework. Formalize only the finite-dimensional Magic
Square consequence needed here; do not introduce a project-wide LCS or
approximate-representation mechanism.

### Target

After the Magic Square foundation/split packet #75, prove only the existing
`MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_ms_rigidity` in
`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/MagicSquareTheorems.lean`, preserving its complete public
signature verbatim:

- one universal `C : ℝ` with `1 ≤ C`, before `ε` and `S`;
- every `ε ≥ 0` and every `S : Strategy msGame` with `1 - ε ≤ S.value`;
- an `MsRigidityWitness S`;
- the Euclidean state bound;
- Alice and Bob measurement-distance bounds at zero-based variables 0/X and
  4/Z;
- both anticommutator-distance bounds;
- all seven bounds at scale `C * Real.sqrt ε`.

### Dependencies

- Base on merged #75.
- Base on #49 for the clean state-dependent distance/observable conversion and
  triangle API, especially `opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le`,
  `consistencyDefect_postprocess_le`, and `povm_to_obs` where applicable.
- Base on #64 for clean EPR normalization and the Pauli-projector/observable
  expansions used to identify `idealMagicBitProj`.
- Base on #68 for the binary Pauli involution and twisted-commutation laws.
- It is independent of the perfect-strategy packet, #69, the fixed-field-model
  work, and encoding/decoding. Once the split and these three dependencies
  land, rigidity and perfect strategy may run concurrently in disjoint files.

### Proof route

1. Expand the game value over the 36 directed constraint-variable incidences.
   Convert `1 - ε ≤ S.value` into rejection-mass bounds, then into the
   finitely many row/column consistency relations with explicit constants.
   Include bounds for wrong-form answers folded by `msBitOrZero`; they are not
   definitionally absent.
2. Reduce arbitrary finite POVMs to projective measurements without
   strengthening the theorem. Reuse or adapt the proved one-measurement and
   tensor-product Naimark machinery in
   `MIPStarRE/LDT/MakingMeasurementsProjective/NaimarkFull.lean`, but prove the
   pure-vector/intertwining consequences actually needed here: value
   preservation, composition of the input-space embeddings with the eventual
   self-test isometries, and transfer of state-dependent effect bounds back to
   the original strategy.
3. For the dilated projective strategy, turn the six nearly satisfied parity
   constraints and same-cell agreement into approximate reflection relations.
   Isolate a proved, file-local projective Magic Square rigidity lemma;
   projectivity must be discharged by step 2, not exposed in
   `exists_ms_rigidity`.
4. Follow the finite Magic Square operator argument: extract approximate Pauli
   `X` and `Z` pairs for the two logical qubits, construct the local swap
   isometries, and obtain a normalized auxiliary vector. Keep all intermediate
   relation/error lemmas concrete and proved. Do not restate
   Coladangelo--Stark's general theorem as an axiom or assumed proposition.
5. Translate the cited theorem's ideal observables `I⊗Z` and `ZX⊗ZX` through
   the explicit local basis change to the project's `X⊗I` and `Z⊗I`. Use
   #64/#68 to identify the corresponding
   binary effects with `idealMagicBitProj`.
6. Convert the self-test's density/trace estimate to the exact Euclidean vector
   estimate. Account for the square-root loss explicitly; this is not a
   definitional `simpa`.
7. Derive the four `msOperatorDistanceA/B` bounds, then the two
   `msAnticommutatorDistanceA/B` bounds from binary observable expansion,
   multiplication stability, and the squared-distance triangle estimates from
   #49.
8. Track explicit constants throughout and take a finite maximum to obtain the
   single universal `C ≥ 1`. Handle the theorem's unrestricted `ε ≥ 0`: use
   the robust argument in its small-error range and a separately
   proved coarse large-error bound with canonical padded isometries. Do not
   silently assume `ε ≤ 1`.

Private implementation submodules under
`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/MagicSquareTheorems/Rigidity/` are allowed when they keep
individual proofs reviewable. They remain owned by this one issue and must
bottom out in Lean/Mathlib and the already proved local APIs.

### Statement integrity

Paper assumptions: an arbitrary finite-dimensional strategy whose Magic Square
success is `1-ε`. Lean uses arbitrary finite local carriers, a unit pure state,
arbitrary POVMs, nonnegative `ε`, and a lower success bound; the
lower-bound form is the faithful monotone version of the source equality.
Paper conclusion: local isometries extracting two EPR pairs and an auxiliary
state, four binary measurement approximations, and Alice/Bob anticommutation,
all with universal `O(sqrt ε)` control. Lean records exactly these
through `MsRigidityWitness`, `idealMsState`, `msOperatorDistanceA/B`, and
`msAnticommutatorDistanceA/B`; indices 0 and 4 are the paper's variables 1 and
5. Verdict: faithful explicit-constant encoding.

The paper explains two translations at lines 650-652: trace norm to Euclidean
distance and a local basis change. Both are proof obligations. No additional
strategy-projectivity assumption, bridge package, residual input, or changed
error exponent is source-faithful.

### Ownership and non-goals

Own `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/MagicSquareTheorems.lean` and, if needed, new private
rigidity-only submodules below
`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/MagicSquareTheorems/Rigidity/`. Do not touch
`MagicSquare.lean`, `MagicSquareTheorems/Basic.lean`,
`MagicSquareTheorems/PerfectStrategy.lean`, Pauli/distance source files,
blueprint, re-exports, or downstream soundness files.

Do not add `S.IsProjective`, restrict the strategy dimension, drop either
player's conclusions, omit the wrong-form answer analysis, move `C` under
`ε` or `S`, replace `sqrt ε` by a weaker rate, add an
external-theorem axiom, leave a conditional self-test helper, or create a
general LCS/group-stability framework. Do not add new issues merely for
mechanisms discovered during proof work; keep necessary private lemmas in this
packet.

### Acceptance

- `exists_ms_rigidity` is complete with its exact existing signature and all
  seven bounds.
- Every helper on its proof path is kernel-checked; its `#print axioms` output
  contains no `sorryAx` or new axiom.
- The owned file/submodules contain no `sorry`, `admit`, prohibited bypass,
  conditional bridge, or `**Unfaithful:**` dependency.
- The statement-integrity audit explicitly records POVM generality, quantifier
  order, zero-based indices, the universal constant, trace-to-Euclidean
  conversion, local basis change, and the large-error branch.
- Focused rigidity modules and `MIPStarRE/QPBT.lean` type-check; full build,
  declaration check, blueprint render/status checks, diff check, exact-head CI,
  and independent review pass.
- Existing blueprint declaration links remain unchanged; no new `\leanok` claim
  is added.

---
Stage 4.3 proof packet under #47.

 "body": "<!-- mipstarre-issue-key: stage43-direct-low-degree-geometry -->\n### Motivation\n\n- Parent: #47.\n- Depends on the structural split in #67.\n- The direct-index game already defines the repaired axis and diagonal sampling\n  laws, but its five elementary geometry statements remain admitted.\n- These statements are the direct-index counterparts of `lem:alnf` and\n  `lem:dlnf`, paper\n  `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:243-272`\n  and blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:61-85`.\n- Proving them unlocks the native-LDT adapter without restoring the invalid\n  dimension-divisibility assumption.\n\n### Targets\n\nIn `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Geometry.lean`, replace only the\nexisting proofs of:\n\n- `directALinePointDist_point_index_marginal_uniform`\n- `directALinePointDist_mem_line`\n- `directDLinePointDist_point_index_marginal_uniform`\n- `directDLinePointDist_mem_line`\n- `directDLinePointDist_prefix_zero`\n\nPreserve every declaration name, argument, result type, and docstring.\n\n### Proof order\n\n1. Add only private, file-local helpers needed for finite-distribution\n   extensionality, composition of probability-preserving pushforwards, and\n   uniform projection along an explicit finite equivalence.\n2. Exhibit `DirectLdSpace D` as both point times index/direction and index times\n   point/direction. Use those equivalences and Mathlib's uniform-PMF transport\n   and product results to prove both point/index marginal conjunctions.\n3. Prove the private fact `u \u2208 linePoints (lineRepMap v u) v`.  "body": "<!-- mipstarre-issue-key: stage43-binary-coordinate-multiplication -->\n### Context\n\nIssue #65 relocates and proves the self-dual-basis existence layer upstream.\nAfter it merges, the sole remaining proof hole in `SelfDualBasis.lean` is the\nfirst equality of paper Equation `eq:eq-mult`.\n\nThis packet is serialized after #65 because both change `SelfDualBasis.lean`;\nthe multiplication proof itself does not use basis existence, self-duality, or\nnormality.\n\n### Target and ownership\n\nProve the existing theorem `MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryCoordinates_mul` without\nchanging its signature. Own only\n`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/SelfDualBasis.lean`, based on main after #65 merges.\n\n### Proof strategy\n\nExpand `a` in the stored basis with `F.basis.sum_equivFun a`, distribute\nmultiplication by `b` over the finite sum, use `Algebra.smul_mul_assoc`, and map\nthe resulting sum and scalar multiples through the linear coordinate\nequivalence. This exact proof shape has been scratch-elaborated:\n\n\u200b`\u200b`\u200b`lean\n  rw [\u2190 F.basis.sum_equivFun a, Finset.sum_mul]\n  simp only [Module.Basis.equivFun_apply, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_sum,\n    map_smul, Module.Basis.sum_repr]\n\u200b`\u200b`\u200b`\n\nKeep the final proof explicit enough that it cannot depend accidentally on the\ntarget theorem itself.\n\n### Source integrity\n\n- Paper: `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:669-700`, Equation\n  `eq:eq-mult`.\n- Blueprint: `blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:313-334`,\n  `def:binary-representation`.\n\nVerdict: faithful fixed-model encoding. The conclusion is exactly the first\nequality of `eq:eq-mult`; `FixedFieldModel` packages the paper's once-fixed\nbasis. No additional hypothesis or altered constant is required. The proof is\nbasis-generic internally and does not use the stored self-duality, normality,\nadmissibility, or natural-serialization fields.\n\n### Non-goals\n\n- Do not revisit #65's basis predicates, existence theorem, or field-model\n  construction.\n- Do not change `binaryCoordinates`, `FixedFieldModel`, or\n  `binaryRepresentation`.\n- Do not modify the already-proved `binaryCoordinates_basis_mul`, the second\n  equality of `eq:eq-mult`.\n- Do not prove trace-coordinate lemmas in `SelfDualBasisTheorems.lean`.\n- Do not add helpers, assumptions, bridge structures, blueprint edits, import\n  churn, or shared re-export edits.\n\n### Acceptance\n\n- `binaryCoordinates_mul` contains no `sorry`, `admit`, axiom, or prohibited\n  bypass, and its signature is unchanged.\n- `#print axioms MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryCoordinates_mul` contains no `sorryAx`.\n- `SelfDualBasis.lean` has no proof debt after merged #65.\n- Focused checks pass for `SelfDualBasis.lean`,\n  `SelfDualBasisTheorems.lean`, and `PauliTheorems.lean`.\n- Blueprint declaration checking, blueprint rendering, `lake build`,\n  `git diff --check`, exact-head CI, and independent review pass.\n- The diff remains confined to the target proof.\n\n---\nStage 4.3 proof packet under #47. Depends on #65.",

 "body": "<!-- mipstarre-issue-key: qpbt-stage43-finite-distribution-normalization -->\n### Motivation\n\nThe QPBT construction uses product sampling, convex mixtures, and dependent\nsampling, but their normalization lemmas remain unfinished. These elementary\nfacts support sandwich distributions, the line-point sampler, and typed\nconditionally linear question distributions.\n\nThe operations are Lean infrastructure for sampling patterns used by the paper;\nthey are not separate paper-labelled theorems.\n\n### Target declarations\n\nProve these existing declarations in\n`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/DistributionAux.lean` without changing their public\nsignatures:\n\n1. `Distribution.prod_isProbability`\n2. `Distribution.mix_isProbability`\n3. `Distribution.bind_isProbability`\n\n### Sources\n\n- Independent product sampling in the sandwich construction:\n  `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:465-501` and\n  `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:398-425`.\n- The equal mixture defining the line-point distribution:\n  `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`\n  and `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:85-95`.\n- Conditional sampling in typed conditionally linear distributions:\n  `references/qpbt-paper/07_types.tex:84-94` and\n  `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:624-629`.\n\n### Proof plan\n\n- Expand `Distribution.IsProbability`, `Distribution.totalWeight`, and the\n  corresponding operation.\n- For `prod`, rewrite the sum over the product support as iterated sums, factor\n  the inner sum, and apply both normalization hypotheses.\n- For `mix`, distribute the sum over the union support, use\n  `Distribution.outsideSupport` to replace each union sum by its original\n  support sum, then apply the normalization hypotheses and simplify the convex\n  coefficients.\n- For `bind`, commute the finite sums over the union support and the outer\n  support. For each supported outer value, use `outsideSupport` to reduce the\n  union sum to the corresponding inner support, then apply `h\u03bd` and finally\n  `h\u03bc`.\n\nPrefer existing Mathlib finite-sum lemmas and the\n`Distribution.IsProbability.weight_sum_eq_one` API.\n\n### Scope and non-goals\n\n- Own only `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/DistributionAux.lean`.\n- Do not change `Distribution.prod`, `Distribution.mix`, `Distribution.bind`,\n  their supports or weights, or any public theorem signature.\n- Do not touch `Distribution.restrict_isProbability`, line geometry, downstream\n  QPBT proofs, re-export files, or blueprint proof status.\n- Do not add bridge assumptions, conditional helpers, axioms, or new proof\n  holes. Keep any genuinely useful support lemma private.\n- This packet depends only on the merged `MIPStarRE.LDT.Basic.Distribution` API.\n  It is independent of PRs #46, #48, and #49 and may run in parallel with them.\n\n### Acceptance\n\n- All three targets contain complete kernel-checked proofs with unchanged\n  signatures.\n- `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/DistributionAux.lean` contains no `sorry`, `admit`,\n  axiom, or prohibited bypass.\n- `#print axioms` for all three targets contains no `sorryAx`.\n- The target file and its direct consumers type-check; `lake build` and\n  `git diff --check` pass.\n- The PR passes exact-head local CI and independent review.\n\n---\nStage 4.3 proof packet under #47.\n",

 "body": "<!-- mipstarre-issue-key: qpbt-stage43-qudit-to-qubit-isometry -->\n### Motivation\n\nComplete `lem:pauli-binary`, the qudit-to-qubit identification used by QPBT\nsoundness. The source statement is\n`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1163-1199`, with proof at lines\n1201-1262. The matched blueprint node is\n`blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:711-781`.\n\n### Target declaration\n\nProve only `MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_qubitIsometry` in\n`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/PauliTheorems.lean`, preserving its public signature\nexactly. Preserve `qubitPauliProj` and the existing `**Local fix:**` paragraph\ncorrecting the source's erroneous factor range `j in {1, ..., q}` to\n`Fin F.basisDim`, where `basisDim = log2 q`.\n\n### Dependencies and serialization\n\n- Base this packet on merged #64, which proves\n  `pauliProj_eq_avg_tauObservable`.\n- Base it on merged #66, which proves the self-dual trace and coordinate\n  identities, especially `binTrace_mul_eq_dotProduct`.\n- Start only after #68 has merged because both packets own\n  `PauliTheorems.lean`. This is a file-ownership dependency, not a mathematical\n  dependency on #68's Pauli-relation or cancellation targets.\n- The theorem receives `F : FixedFieldModel q` as data and does not depend on\n  #65's proof that such models exist.\n\n### Proof route\n\n1. Define a private label equivalence by applying\n   `F.binaryCoordinates.toEquiv` at each `Fin L` coordinate and then\n   uncurrying:\n\n   \u200b`\u200b`\u200b`lean\n   (Equiv.piCongrRight (fun _ : Fin L => F.binaryCoordinates.toEquiv)).trans\n     (Equiv.curry (Fin L) (Fin F.basisDim) (ZMod 2)).symm\n   \u200b`\u200b`\u200b`\n\n   Lift it to `phi` with `LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 C C`.\n\n2. Prove a private generic EPR transport lemma for a finite equivalence. Expand\n   `isometryTensor` and `eprState`, use\n   `EuclideanSpace.piLpCongrLeft_single`, rewrite the normalization with\n   `Fintype.card_congr`, and collapse the two permutation sums with\n   `Fintype.sum_eq_single`.\n\n3. Prove a private generic conjugation lemma identifying conjugation by the\n   inverse coordinate isometry with `Matrix.reindex` by the inverse label\n   equivalence. Collapse the two matrix-product sums explicitly. Keep the\n   orientation: `phi` maps qudit labels to bit labels, while `phi.symm`\n   realizes the paper's `phi^dagger M phi` on the qudit space.\n\n4. Establish private phase compatibility for `a,u : Fin L -> F.K` by combining\n   trace linearity, `binTrace_mul_eq_dotProduct F`,\n   `Algebra.trace_self_apply`, and `Fintype.sum_prod_type`.\n\n5. Prove entrywise transport of `tauObservable` for both `PauliKind.X` and\n   `.Z`. Use linearity and injectivity of `F.binaryCoordinates` in the shift\n   case and phase compatibility in the phase case.\n\n6. Rewrite both projectors with #64's\n   `pauliProj_eq_avg_tauObservable`, transport the finite sum along the label\n   equivalence with `Fintype.sum_equiv`, rewrite its normalization by\n   `Fintype.card_congr`, and apply observable and phase transport termwise.\n\nThe coordinate equivalence, its `piLpCongrLeft` lift, generic EPR transport,\nand generic conjugation/reindex proof have been scratch-elaborated successfully\nagainst the current imports.\n\n### Statement integrity\n\nThe paper assumes an admissible binary field size `q = 2^k`, its fixed\nself-dual normal basis, and a nonnegative tensor exponent. `FixedFieldModel q`\npackages exactly that field/basis boundary, and `L : Nat` includes the paper's\nempty tensor-power case. The two Lean conclusions are exactly the source EPR\nand `X`/`Z` projector identities. Verdict: **faithful boundary hypotheses**,\nwith the already documented source index correction; no extra assumptions and\nno weakened or strengthened conclusion.\n\n### Scope and integrity constraints\n\n- Own only the proof of `exists_qubitIsometry` and private helpers needed for\n  it in `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/PauliTheorems.lean`.\n- Do not edit `Pauli.lean`, `SelfDualBasisTheorems.lean`, blueprint files,\n  re-export files, or any other declaration in `PauliTheorems.lean`.\n- Do not replace the coordinate isometry with an arbitrary cardinality\n  equivalence; compatibility with `kappaVec F` is load-bearing.\n- Do not reverse `phi` and `phi.symm`, handle only one Pauli kind, or add a\n  positivity or nonemptiness assumption that would exclude `L = 0`.\n- Do not add public transport infrastructure, bridge assumptions, conditional\n  helpers, axioms, proof bypasses, or new proof holes.\n- Use #64 and #66 only after their proofs merge so this target has no\n  transitive `sorryAx`. No blueprint proof-status edit belongs to this\n  Lean-only packet.\n\n### Acceptance\n\n- The target `sorry` is removed and its public signature and documentation are\n  unchanged.\n- `#print axioms MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_qubitIsometry` contains no `sorryAx`.\n- After #68, `PauliTheorems.lean` contains no remaining `sorry`, `admit`, new\n  axiom, or prohibited bypass.\n- The direct file check, proof-debt scan, target build, and full build pass.\n- Declaration checking, blueprint rendering/status checks, and\n  `git diff --check` pass without a blueprint change.\n- The PR r",

 "body": "<!-- mipstarre-issue-key: stage43-qpbt-core-distance-calculus -->\n### Motivation\n\nStage 4.2 established the QPBT distance interfaces. Stage 4.3 now needs their\nelementary proofs throughout the Chapter 14 observable analysis, Chapter 15\ncombination argument, and Chapter 16 extraction argument.\n\nThis issue closes the reusable distance-calculus layer without taking on the\nimported projectivization theorem or strategy-value stability.\n\n### Target declarations\n\nProve these existing declarations in `Games/DistanceTheorems.lean` without\nchanging their public signatures:\n\n1. `opFamilyDistSq_le_two_mul_consistencyDefect`\n2. `consistencyDefect_le_opFamilyDistSq_of_projective`\n3. `consistencyDefect_le_sqrt_of_projective_left`\n4. `opFamilyDistSq_mul_left_le`\n5. `opFamilyDistSq_mul_funIndexed_le`\n6. `opDistSq_sum_sub_mul_le_of_projective`\n7. `opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le`\n8. `consistencyDefect_trans_le`\n9. `consistencyDefect_postprocess_le`\n10. `opDistSq_commutator_le`\n11. `avg_closeness`\n12. `povm_to_obs`\n\n### Sources and proof order\n\n- Agreement and multiplication:\n  `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:295-380`.\n- Squared and consistency triangle inequalities:\n  `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:383-395` and\n  `references/ldt-paper/preliminaries.tex:649-666`.\n- Data processing and commutation analysis:\n  `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:397-461`.\n- Averaging and POVM-to-observable conversion:\n  `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:95-131`.\n- Blueprint counterparts:\n  `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:245-389` and\n  `blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:282-373`.\n\nFirst prove the pointwise norm, PSD-order, finite-sum, and averaging facts. Then\nderive consistency transitivity using the proved LDT analogue\n`MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.simeqTriangleInequality`, and derive the commutator\nbound from multiplication stability and the squared triangle inequality.\n\n### Statement integrity\n\nPreserve every explicit constant and the current quantifier order. Do not add\nprobability, positivity, projectivity, bridge, residual, or generic assumptions.\n\nPaper `fact:agreement` item 3 allows either measurement family to be\nprojective, while the current Lean declaration exposes only the left-projective\nbranch. Issue #33 owns the additive source-facing wrapper decision. Prove the\nexisting branch here, but do not mark the grouped blueprint proof complete until\n#33 supplies a faithful interface or records the grouping correction.\n\n### Ownership and non-goals\n\n- Own `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/DistanceTheorems.lean`.\n- Own only proof-status edits for the corresponding nodes in Chapters 12 and 14.\n- Keep support lemmas private or file-local where practical.\n- Do not change `Distance`, `Consistency`, measurement, or strategy definitions.\n- Exclude `abs_value_sub_le_of_areClose` and\n  `exists_projective_close_of_consistent`; each receives a separate packet.\n- Do not prove downstream Chapter 14-16 theorems or optimize universal constants.\n- Do not add conditional helpers or proof-obligation packages.\n\n### Acceptance\n\n- All twelve targets contain no `sorry`, `admit`, axiom, or prohibited bypass.\n- `#print axioms` for each target contains no `sorryAx`.\n- The file proof-debt scan reports only the two excluded declarations.\n- Statement-integrity results are recorded for the source-linked nodes.\n- The single-file Lean check, blueprint axiom/status check, blueprint render,\n  declaration check, full build, exact-head CI, and independent review pass.\n\n---\nStage 4.3 proof packet under #47.",

 "body": "<!-- mipstarre-issue-key: qpbt-stage43-epr-binary-fourier -->\n### Motivation\n\nThe concrete EPR vector and binary Pauli eigenbasis are already defined, but\ntheir normalization and Fourier expansion laws remain proof holes. These facts\nare prerequisites for the later Pauli algebra and qudit-to-qubit arguments.\n\n`eprState_norm` certifies the unit-vector property implicit in `def:EPR`. The\nother two targets are characteristic-two specializations of the paper's\ngeneral-prime Fourier formulas.\n\n### Target declarations\n\nProve these existing declarations in `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/Pauli.lean`\nwithout changing their public signatures:\n\n1. `eprState_norm`\n2. `tauObservable_eq_sum_pauliProj`\n3. `pauliProj_eq_avg_tauObservable`\n\n### Sources\n\n- EPR state: `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:946-955` and\n  `blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:519-548`.\n- Multi-qudit Pauli eigenbases, expansion, and inversion:\n  `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1097-1161` and\n  `blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:550-701`.\n- Existing Fourier orthogonality API:\n  `MIPStarRE/LDT/Preliminaries/FiniteFields.lean`, especially `ffChar_apply`,\n  `fourier_fact_scalar`, and `fourier_fact_vector`.\n\n### Proof plan\n\n- For `eprState_norm`, transport through `EuclideanSpace.equiv`, compute the\n  squared norm of the coordinate function, reduce the sum to diagonal pairs,\n  and use nonemptiness to justify the square-root normalization.\n- Add the lower-level finite-field Fourier import and prove only private\n  adapters identifying `phaseSign` with the canonical additive character at\n  characteristic two.\n- Transport `fourier_fact_vector` along `Fintype.equivFin` to obtain\n  orthogonality for the arbitrary finite index type in these statements.\n- Prove `tauObservable_eq_sum_pauliProj` entrywise. Split on `W`: the `Z` case\n  collapses computational-basis projectors; the `X` case expands rank-one\n  entries and applies binary character orthogonality.\n- Derive `pauliProj_eq_avg_tauObservable` by substituting the forward expansion,\n  exchanging finite sums, and applying the same orthogonality relation.\n\n### Statement integrity\n\nThe EPR theorem is faithful for any nonempty finite carrier. The Fourier\ntheorems intentionally assume an algebra over `ZMod 2` and use `phaseSign`, so\nthey cover the admissible QPBT regime `q = 2^k`, not the paper's unrestricted\nprime-characteristic formulas.\n\nAdd `**Scope restriction:**` to both Fourier theorem docstrings, citing\n`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_characteristic-two-pauli-scope.tex`. Do not link these\nbinary specializations to the unrestricted blueprint node or add `\\leanok`\nthere.\n\n### Ownership and non-goals\n\n- Own only `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/Pauli.lean`.\n- Preserve all definitions and public theorem signatures.\n- Keep character, reindexing, and finite-sum adapters private.\n- Do not prove results in `PauliTheorems.lean`, construct the fixed field model,\n  or change qudit-to-qubit, subspace, extraction, blueprint, or re-export code.\n- Do not add bridge assumptions, axioms, conditional helpers, or new proof\n  holes.\n\nThis packet depends only on the existing `FieldBasis`, finite-matrix, and LDT\nfinite-field Fourier APIs.  "body": "<!-- mipstarre-issue-key: qpbt-stage43-orthogonal-complement-identities -->\n### Parent and objective\n\nStage 4.3 proof packet under #47. Prove the two conclusions of `lem:perp_perp`\nand the kernel identity for the canonical perpendicular projector.\n\n### Source contract\n\nCanonical source: `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:241-282`\n(`lem:perp_perp`) and `:386-418` (`def:Lperp`, `lem:L_perp_perp`). Blueprint:\n`blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:31-66,149-175`.\n\nThe dimension and double-orthogonal statements are exact faithful\nfinite-coordinate encodings, generalized harmlessly to any field and an empty\nindex type. The kernel statement faithfully elides the paper's inessential\nchoice of a basis of `ker L ^perp`; the blueprint explicitly records that basis\nindependence. No extra hypothesis or weakened conclusion is permitted.\n\n### Exact targets\n\nIn `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/SubspacesTheorems.lean`, replace only these three\nproof holes without changing their signatures:\n\n```lean\ntheorem finrank_add_finrank_dotOrthogonal (W : Submodule K (\u03b9 \u2192 K)) :\n    Module.finrank K W + Module.finrank K (dotOrthogonal W) =\n      Fintype.card \u03b9 := by\n  ...\n\ntheorem dotOrthogonal_dotOrthogonal (W : Submodule K (\u03b9 \u2192 K)) :\n    dotOrthogonal (dotOrthogonal W) = W := by\n  ...\n\ntheorem ker_canonicalProjPerp {n : \u2115} [Fintype (Fin n)]\n    [DecidableEq (Fin n)]\n    (L : (Fin n \u2192 K) \u2192\u2097[K] (Fin n \u2192 K)) :\n    LinearMap.ker (canonicalProjPerp L) =\n      dotOrthogonal (LinearMap.ker L) := by\n  ...\n```\n\n### Recommended proof route\n\nDefine a private coordinate bilinear form with `dotProductBilin K K`. Prove it\nreflexive using `dotProduct_comm`, nondegenerate by testing a vector against\n`Pi.single i 1`, and identify its Mathlib orthogonal with `dotOrthogonal` by\nextensionality.\n\nUse `LinearMap.BilinForm.finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal'`, nondegeneracy,\n`finrank_bot`, and `Module.finrank_pi` for the dimension formula. Use\n`LinearMap.BilinForm.orthogonal_orthogonal` with reflexivity and nondegeneracy\nfor the double-orthogonal identity. Minimal imports experimentally sufficient\ninclude `Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForm.Orthogonal` and\n`Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.BilinearForm`; scope helpers precisely to avoid\nunused-variable warnings.\n\nAfter #72 merges, unfold `canonicalProjPerp` and `canonicalProjOfKernel`; the\nkernel target reduces directly to `Submodule.ker_projection`, or the equivalent\n`ker_projectionOnto` chain, applied to\n`isCompl_registerSubmodule_canonicalComplement ... .symm`.\n\nThese proof skeletons were compiled in isolated `/tmp` files against the\ncurrent checkout without changing the repository.\n\n### Ownership and non-goals\n\nOwn only `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/SubspacesTheorems.lean`. Do not modify\n`Subspaces.lean`, definitions, blueprint links, exports, or unrelated algebra.\nDo not add positive-definiteness assumptions: finite-field dot products can be\nisotropic. Do not introduce basis choices, bridges, axioms, or new public\nmechanisms.\n\n### Dependencies and ordering\n\nDispatch in parallel with #72: the first two theorems are independent and can\nbe completed immediately. The third theorem and this packet's final axiom audit\nand merge depend on #72 because `canonicalProjOfKernel` currently embeds its\ncomplement proof. Rebase after #72 lands. The blueprint groups both\n`lem:perp_perp` declarations under one `\\leanok`, so both must be clean together.\n\n### Acceptance\n\n- All three exact signatures are proved without `sorry`, `admit`, axioms, or\n  proof-evasion mechanisms.\n- `lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/SubspacesTheorems.lean` succeeds and the\n  owned file has no proof holes.\n- `#print axioms` for all three theorems, `canonicalProjOfKernel`, and\n  `canonicalProjPerp` contains no `sorryAx` after rebasing on #72.\n- Existing blueprint links remain valid; no new link is added for the\n  unformalized RREF-equivalence claim.\n- Direct consumers type-check, followed by `lake build`.\n- The PR records statement-integrity verdicts `exact faithful finite-index\n  encoding`, `exact faithful`, and `faithful quotienting of an inessential\n  basis choice` for the three targets.\n- Exact-head local CI and independent review pass.\n\n---\nStage 4.3 proof packet under #47.\n",

 "body": "<!-- mipstarre-issue-key: stage43-direct-low-degree-game-value -->
### Motivation

- Parent: #47.
- Depends only on the structural split in #67 and may proceed in parallel with
  the geometry packet #71 once that split lands.
- The direct low-degree game has nine uniformly sampled ordered type branches,
  while the mature low-degree-test hypothesis weights the point/point branch by
  `1 / 3` and each of the four line/point orientations by `1 / 6`.
- Isolating the resulting rejection calculus gives the later native-LDT adapter
  its exact scalar error budget without changing the final soundness theorem or
  introducing a bridge hypothesis.
- Sources: QPBT paper
  `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-392`,
  blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:87-121`, and the mature
  LDT strategy interface in
  `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:130-151` and
  `MIPStarRE/LDT/Test/StrategyBiProj/Measurements.lean:455-528`.

### Target

Create only
`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/GameValue.lean`, importing
`MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.DirectLowDegree.Game`.

Define the private Born weight of an answer pair for a fixed direct question
pair, then add these public quantities and lemmas with the stated signatures:

```lean
noncomputable def directLdBranchRejectionProbability
    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
    (types : LdType × LdType) : ℝ

noncomputable def directLdRejectionProbability
    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) : ℝ

noncomputable def directLdLdtWeightedFailureProbability
    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) : ℝ

theorem directLdBranchRejectionProbability_nonneg
    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
    (types : LdType × LdType) :
    0 ≤ directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S types

theorem directLdRejectionProbability_eq_one_sub_value
    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) :
    directLdRejectionProbability D S = 1 - S.value

theorem directLdLdtWeightedFailureProbability_le_three_mul_rejection
    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) :
    directLdLdtWeightedFailureProbability D S ≤
      3 * directLdRejectionProbability D S

theorem directLdLdtWeightedFailureProbability_le_three_mul_error
    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
    (ε : ℝ) (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) :
    directLdLdtWeightedFailureProbability D S ≤ 3 * ε
```

`directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S types` is the uniform average over
`DirectLdSpace D` of the Born weights of rejected answer pairs for the fixed
ordered type pair. `directLdRejectionProbability` is its uniform average over
`LdType × LdType`. If `B` abbreviates the branch probability, define the
mature-LDT-weighted failure probability as

```text
((B (aline, point) + B (point, aline)) / 2

  + (B (dline, point) + B (point, dline)) / 2) / 3.
```

   strategy state's normalization.
3. Partition answer pairs into accepted and rejected outcomes for each fixed
   question and type pair.

   product averaging, to identify total rejection with `1 - S.value`.

   branches omitted by the mature LDT expression gives the exact factor-three
   inequality.

direct game. The factor three records the exact comparison between the game's

 "body": "<!-- mipstarre-issue-key: stage43-direct-low-degree-proof-split -->\n### Motivation\n\n- Parent: #47.\n- `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree.lean` currently combines the\n  direct-index geometry, game definition, and final soundness obligation in one\n  file.\n- Stage 4.3 needs independent geometry, game-calculus, native-LDT adapter,\n  bounds, and simultaneous-encoding packets. Keeping the current layout makes\n  those packets converge on one file or creates an import cycle when the public\n  theorem imports their helper results.\n- This issue is structural only. It must preserve the public API and all six\n  existing proof holes exactly.\n\n### Description\n\nSplit the existing file at its current declaration boundaries:\n\n1. Create `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Geometry.lean`.\n\n   - Import `MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.LowDegreeGameTheorems` and\n     `MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.PauliBasisTest`.\n   - Move, without renaming, reordering, signature changes, or proof changes,\n     the declarations currently spanning `DirectLdParams` through\n     `directDLinePointDist_prefix_zero` (`DirectLowDegree.lean:39-266`).\n   - Retain the five existing `sorry` proofs unchanged.\n\n2. Create `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Game.lean`.\n\n   - Import `MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.DirectLowDegree.Geometry`.\n   - Move verbatim the declarations from `DirectDegPoly` through\n     `evalDirectPolyTupleAt` (`DirectLowDegree.lean:268-455`).\n\n3. Create `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Soundness.lean`.\n\n   - Import `MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.DirectLowDegree.Game`.\n   - Move `exists_direct_ld_soundness` and its docstring\n     (`DirectLowDegree.lean:457-497`) verbatim.\n   - Retain its existing `sorry` proof unchanged.\n\n4. Turn `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree.lean` into the stable facade.\n\n   - Preserve its existing module docstring.\n   - Replace its implementation imports with\n     `MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.DirectLowDegree.Soundness`.\n   - Continue exposing every declaration under the same fully qualified name.\n\nEach new internal file must have the required module docstring and use the\nexisting `MIPStarRE.QPBT` namespace. Apart from those docstrings, imports, and\nnamespace wrappers, moved declaration text must remain unchanged.\n\n### Non-goals\n\n- Do not prove or alter any theorem, add helper declarations, or change the\n  proof-debt inventory.\n- Do not edit `MIPStarRE/QPBT.lean`, `Witnesses.lean`, `Apply.lean`, blueprint\n  files, or paper-gap notes.\n- Do not change any mathematical definition, theorem signature, constant, or\n  source claim.\n\nThis split establishes disjoint ownership for later geometry, game-value,\nnative-adapter, bounds, simultaneous-encoding, and final-assembly packets. Only\nthe final assembly packet will edit `Soundness.lean`.\n\n### Testing\n\n- Direct-check `Geometry.lean`, `Game.lean`, `Soundness.lean`, the facade, and\n  `Combining/Witnesses.lean` in dependency order.\n- Run `lake build` and `git diff --check`.\n- Confirm the four-file surface contains exactly six `sorry` sites: five in\n  `Geometry.lean` and one in `Soundness.lean`, with no `admit` or new axiom.\n- Confirm all existing declaration names and signatures are unchanged.\n- Confirm `MIPStarRE/QPBT.lean` is untouched.\n- Pass exact-head CI and independent review.\n\n---\nStage 4.3 structural packet under #47.\n",

 "body": "<!-- mipstarre-issue-key: stage43-fixed-self-dual-field-model -->\n### Context\n\nStage 4.3 needs an actual fixed binary field model for every admissible size.\nThe current proof graph is cyclic: `exists_fixed_field_model` is declared in\n`FieldBasis.lean`, while the self-dual normal-basis theorem needed to construct\nit is declared downstream in `SelfDualBasis.lean`.\n\nThis packet closes only that existence long pole. It does not take on coordinate\nidentities or Pauli algebra.\n\n### Target declarations\n\nProve these existing declarations without changing their public signatures:\n\n1. `MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_selfDualNormalBasis`\n2. `MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_fixed_field_model`\n\nPreserve `FixedFieldModel`, `fixedFieldModel`, `binaryRepresentation`, and their\nfields and signatures exactly.\n\n### Acyclic foundation design\n\nUse `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/FieldBasis.lean` as the upstream foundation; do not\nadd another module or touch the shared `MIPStarRE/QPBT.lean` re-export.\n\nMove these declarations verbatim from `SelfDualBasis.lean` into\n`FieldBasis.lean`, before they are needed by `exists_fixed_field_model`:\n\n- `IsDualBasisPair`\n- `Basis.IsSelfDual`\n- `Basis.IsNormal`\n- `exists_selfDualNormalBasis`\n\nTheir fully qualified names, types, documentation, and blueprint links must\nremain unchanged. Since `SelfDualBasis.lean` imports `FieldBasis.lean`,\ndownstream visibility remains unchanged without aliases or duplicate theorems.\n\n### Mathematical construction\n\nFor `exists_fixed_field_model`, unpack `IsAdmissibleSize q` as odd `k` with\n`q = 2^k`, use a genuine binary finite field such as `GaloisField 2 k`, and\nselect the proved self-dual normal basis.\n\nConstruct the carrier equivalence to `Fin (2^k)` from the basis-coordinate\nequivalence and an exact little-endian bit encoding. Prove\n`representation_natural` as stated: coordinate `i` contributes `2^i` exactly\nwhen that coordinate is one. An arbitrary cardinality equivalence is not\nacceptable because it does not establish this equation.\n\n### External theorem boundary\n\nMathlib proves the normal-basis theorem via `IsGalois.normalBasis`, but currently\ncontains no theorem producing a basis that is simultaneously self-dual and\nnormal. The remaining mathematical input is the characteristic-two,\nodd-extension-degree self-dual normal-basis theorem used by Wang's construction\nin paper lemma `lem:efficient_basis`.\n\nFormalize that existence result as a kernel-checked Lean proof in this packet.\nSupporting trace-pairing, Frobenius-orbit, Gram/circulant-matrix, or change-of-\ngenerator lemmas are in scope only when they directly discharge the theorem.\n\nDo not replace the missing result with an `axiom`, `sorry`, model hypothesis,\nbasis argument, bridge structure, residual package, or choice from an unproved\nexistence claim. If the proof cannot be closed, keep the issue open rather than\nmerging conditional infrastructure.\n\nThis packet proves mathematical existence only. It must not claim to formalize\nthe deterministic polynomial-time algorithms of Shoup, Lenstra, or Wang.\n\n### Ownership and non-goals\n\n- Own `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/FieldBasis.lean`.\n- Own only the declaration relocation and resulting import/docstring cleanup in\n  `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/SelfDualBasis.lean`.\n- Leave `binaryCoordinates_mul` and all coordinate, trace, Fourier, Pauli, and\n  isometry proofs to separate Stage 4.3 packets.\n- Do not change blueprint statements or proof status; existing links use stable\n  fully qualified declaration names.\n- Do not add or edit shared root re-exports.\n\n### Statement integrity\n\nThe paper assumes an odd positive degree and the binary extension\n`F_{2^k}/F_2`; oddness implies positivity. The carrier-generic Lean statement\nusing a finite field, its `ZMod 2` algebra, and cardinality `2^k` is a faithful\nformal encoding.\n\n`exists_fixed_field_model` is a Lean-only once-and-for-all selection theorem.\nIt must derive every stored field from admissibility rather than move any\nconstruction obligation into its assumptions.\n\nRecord explicitly that the mathematical existence statement is proved while\nthe source's algorithmic complexity claim is not formalized.\n\n### Acceptance\n\n- Both target proofs contain no `sorry`, `admit`, axiom, or prohibited bypass.\n- `#print axioms` for both targets and `fixedFieldModel` contains no `sorryAx`.\n- `FieldBasis.lean` has no proof debt.\n- The only pre-existing proof debt left in `SelfDualBasis.lean` is\n  `binaryCoordinates_mul`.\n- Public names and signatures are unchanged, and no import cycle is introduced.\n- Focused checks pass for `FieldBasis`, `SelfDualBasis`,\n  `SelfDualBasisTheorems`, and `PauliTheorems`.\n- Blueprint declaration checking/rendering, the full build, diff check,\n  exact-head CI, and independent review pass.\n\n### Sources\n\n- `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:653-728`\n- `blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:241-257,298-335`\n- Mathlib `FieldTheory/Galois/NormalBasis.lean`\n- Shoup, Lenstra, and Wang references cited by paper lemma `lem:efficient_basis`\n\n---\nStage 4.3 proof packet under #47.\n",

 "body": "<!-- mipstarre-issue-key: qpbt-stage43-epr-binary-fourier -->\n### Motivation\n\nThe concrete EPR vector and binary Pauli eigenbasis are already defined, but\ntheir normalization and Fourier expansion laws remain proof holes. These facts\nare prerequisites for the later Pauli algebra and qudit-to-qubit arguments.\n\n`eprState_norm` certifies the unit-vector property implicit in `def:EPR`. The\nother two targets are characteristic-two specializations of the paper's\ngeneral-prime Fourier formulas.\n\n### Target declarations\n\nProve these existing declarations in `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/Pauli.lean`\nwithout changing their public signatures:\n\n1. `eprState_norm`\n2. `tauObservable_eq_sum_pauliProj`\n3. `pauliProj_eq_avg_tauObservable`\n\n### Sources\n\n- EPR state: `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:946-955` and\n  `blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:519-548`.\n- Multi-qudit Pauli eigenbases, expansion, and inversion:\n  `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1097-1161` and\n  `blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:550-701`.\n- Existing Fourier orthogonality API:\n  `MIPStarRE/LDT/Preliminaries/FiniteFields.lean`, especially `ffChar_apply`,\n  `fourier_fact_scalar`, and `fourier_fact_vector`.\n\n### Proof plan\n\n- For `eprState_norm`, transport through `EuclideanSpace.equiv`, compute the\n  squared norm of the coordinate function, reduce the sum to diagonal pairs,\n  and use nonemptiness to justify the square-root normalization.\n- Add the lower-level finite-field Fourier import and prove only private\n  adapters identifying `phaseSign` with the canonical additive character at\n  characteristic two.\n- Transport `fourier_fact_vector` along `Fintype.equivFin` to obtain\n  orthogonality for the arbitrary finite index type in these statements.\n- Prove `tauObservable_eq_sum_pauliProj` entrywise. Split on `W`: the `Z` case\n  collapses computational-basis projectors; the `X` case expands rank-one\n  entries and applies binary character orthogonality.\n- Derive `pauliProj_eq_avg_tauObservable` by substituting the forward expansion,\n  exchanging finite sums, and applying the same orthogonality relation.\n\n### Statement integrity\n\nThe EPR theorem is faithful for any nonempty finite carrier. The Fourier\ntheorems intentionally assume an algebra over `ZMod 2` and use `phaseSign`, so\nthey cover the admissible QPBT regime `q = 2^k`, not the paper's unrestricted\nprime-characteristic formulas.\n\nAdd `**Scope restriction:**` to both Fourier theorem docstrings, citing\n`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_characteristic-two-pauli-scope.tex`. Do not link these\nbinary specializations to the unrestricted blueprint node or add `\\leanok`\nthere.\n\n### Ownership and non-goals\n\n- Own only `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/Pauli.lean`.\n- Preserve all definitions and public theorem signatures.\n- Keep character, reindexing, and finite-sum adapters private.\n- Do not prove results in `PauliTheorems.lean`, construct the fixed field model,\n  or change qudit-to-qubit, subspace, extraction, blueprint, or re-export code.\n- Do not add bridge assumptions, axioms, conditional helpers, or new proof\n  holes.\n\nThis packet depends only on the existing `FieldBasis`, finite-matrix, and LDT\nfinite-field Fourier APIs. It is independent of #46, #48, #49, and #61-#63.\n\n### Acceptance\n\n- All three targets are complete with unchanged signatures and no prohibited\n  proof bypass.\n- `Pauli.lean` contains no `sorry`, `admit`, or new axiom.\n- `#print axioms` for all three targets contains no `sorryAx`.\n- A statement-integrity audit records `eprState_norm` as faithful and the two\n  Fourier results as characteristic-two scope restrictions.\n- `Pauli.lean` and `PauliTheorems.lean` type-check.\n- The full build, diff check, exact-head CI, and independent review pass.\n\n---\nStage 4.3 proof packet under #47.\n",

 "body": "<!-- mipstarre-issue-key: qpbt-stage43-generic-encoding-decoding -->\n### Motivation\n\nStage 4.3 needs the elementary low-degree encoding identity and the paper's\nrestricted decoder correctness result. These are the generic algebraic facts\nlater used by the Chapter 16 decoder, without taking on its full-field\nrepresentative API.\n\nBase this work on merged PR #46. That PR adds `decodeFqRep` and `IsEncodingRep`\nto `LowDegreeCodeTheorems.lean`; preserve those declarations unchanged.\n\n### Target declarations\n\nProve these existing declarations without changing their public signatures:\n\n1. `lowDegreeEnc_eq_dotProduct`\n2. `decodeAt_lowDegreeEnc`\n\nThese are the only `sorry` sites in the two owned files at PR #46's head.\n\n### Sources and proof order\n\n- Paper encoding and cube interpolation:\n  `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:873-897`, especially\n  `eq:low-degree-encoding-definition`.\n- Paper restricted decoder identity:\n  `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:917-924`.\n- Blueprint encoding and indicator-vector nodes:\n  `blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:404-440`.\n- Blueprint decoder node `def:decoding-map`:\n  `blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:446-456`.\n\nProceed in dependency order:\n\n1. Prove `lowDegreeEnc_eq_dotProduct` by evaluating the finite sum and scalar\n   multiples.\n2. Prove privately that `indicatorPoly y` evaluated at `cubeEmbed z` is the\n   corresponding Kronecker delta.\n3. Derive a private cube-interpolation lemma\n   `lowDegreeEnc a (cubeEmbed z) = a z`.\n4. Prove `decodeAt_lowDegreeEnc` by function extensionality, interpolation,\n   `ha`, and the defining conditional in `decodeAt`.\n\nKeep support results private unless an existing downstream declaration requires\na public name.\n\n### Statement integrity\n\nThe paper states the dot-product identity over `F_q`; Lean proves the same\nalgebraic identity over any commutative ring. This weakens the ambient\nassumptions without changing the conclusion and is a faithful generalization.\n\nFor decoding, the paper assumes `H` is a subset of `F_q` and `a` lies in\n`H^M`. Lean represents `H` as `Finset K`, membership pointwise as `ha`, and\nrequires decidable equality for finite-set membership. These are faithful\nrepresentation boundary hypotheses. The conclusion is exactly\n`Dec_H(g_a) = a`.\n\nDo not add assumptions, alter quantifier order, or replace either conclusion.\n\n### Ownership and non-goals\n\n- Own only `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/LowDegreeCode.lean` and\n  `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/LowDegreeCodeTheorems.lean`.\n- Remove or update the stale \"proof obligation in stage 4.1\" wording when the\n  proof is filled.\n- Preserve PR #46's `decodeFqRep` and `IsEncodingRep` declarations.\n- Do not edit `Algebra/Decoding.lean` or prove its full-field decoder lemmas.\n- Do not assert `lowDegreeEncoding (decodeFqRep g) = g` for arbitrary `g`.\n  That unrestricted identity is false and is documented in\n  `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`.\n- Do not change encoding/decoder definitions, add public scaffolding, edit\n  `MIPStarRE/QPBT.lean`, or add new proof holes.\n- Do not mark the broader encoding blueprint nodes `\\leanok`; they also contain\n  degree and linearity assertions outside this packet. No blueprint edit is\n  required.\n\n### Acceptance\n\n- Both target proofs contain no `sorry`, `admit`, axiom, or prohibited bypass.\n- `#print axioms` for both targets contains no `sorryAx`.\n- Public signatures and PR #46's surrounding declarations remain unchanged.\n- Both owned files pass direct `lake env lean` checks and proof-debt scans.\n- The targeted module and full project builds pass.\n- Declaration checking and the blueprint axiom audit pass.\n- Exact-head local CI and independent review pass.\n\n---\nStage 4.3 proof packet under #47.\n",

 "body": "<!-- mipstarre-issue-key: qpbt-stage43-full-field-decoder-laws -->\n### Motivation\n\nChapter 16 needs a bounded-polynomial decoder that retains every field value,\nis linear, inverts the low-degree encoding, and agrees with evaluation on\nencoding representatives. The current API has the source-aligned statements,\nbut their five proofs remain open.\n\nThis packet depends on merged PR #46 and on the generic encoding/interpolation\nproofs in #62. It owns only the Chapter 16 `Poly`-facing algebra layer.\n\n### Target declarations\n\nProve these existing declarations in\n`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/Decoding.lean` without changing their public signatures:\n\n1. `lowDegreeEncoding_mem_poly`\n2. `decodeFq_add`\n3. `decodeFq_smul`\n4. `decodeFq_lowDegreeEncoding`\n5. `decodeFq_dotProduct_indicatorVec`\n\n### Sources\n\n- Low-degree encoding and multilinearity:\n  `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:873-897`.\n- Full-field decoding and its linear use in extraction:\n  `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1419-1450`\n  and `:1805-1822`.\n- Blueprint Chapter 16 interface:\n  `blueprint/src/chapter/ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex:11-20`.\n- Required correction to the unrestricted source identity:\n  `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`.\n\n### Proof order\n\n1. Bound each factor of `indicatorPoly` in a fixed variable by degree zero or\n   one, then use the finite product and sum degree bounds with `P.hd` to prove\n   `lowDegreeEncoding_mem_poly`.\n2. Unfold the full-field decoder and prove `decodeFq_add` and `decodeFq_smul`\n   pointwise. The `Finset.univ` specialization is essential because it retains\n   every value; no such linearity is claimed for the Boolean decoder.\n3. Derive `decodeFq_lowDegreeEncoding` from #62's cube-interpolation theorem.\n4. Unfold `IsEncoding`, rewrite by the encoding-representative equality, and\n   use #62's dot-product identity to prove\n   `decodeFq_dotProduct_indicatorVec`.\n\nPrefer existing `MvPolynomial.degreeOf_*` lemmas and keep auxiliary results\nprivate unless a downstream declaration already needs a public name.\n\n### Statement integrity\n\n- `lowDegreeEncoding_mem_poly` discharges the degree side condition implicit in\n  the paper. `P.hd : 1 <= P.d` is a faithful admissibility boundary, not an\n  added bridge assumption.\n- Full-field decoder additivity, scalar linearity, and\n  `Dec(g_h) = h` match the corrected Chapter 16 interface.\n- The hypothesis `hg : IsEncoding g` on\n  `decodeFq_dotProduct_indicatorVec` is mandatory. The source's unrestricted\n  identity is false, as shown by the `g(x) = x^2` counterexample in the gap\n  note. Add a `**Local fix:**` paragraph to this theorem's docstring citing\n  that note; do not weaken or remove `hg`.\n\n### Ownership and non-goals\n\n- Own only `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/Decoding.lean`.\n- Do not edit `LowDegreeCode.lean`, `LowDegreeCodeTheorems.lean`, extraction or\n  combining modules, blueprint files, or `MIPStarRE/QPBT.lean`.\n- Do not change `decodeOn`, `decodeFq`, `encodingPoly`, or `IsEncoding`.\n- Do not replace representative equality in `IsEncoding` with pointwise\n  equality; the latter is insufficient when degrees reach the field size.\n- Do not add bridge assumptions, new public mechanisms, axioms, or proof holes.\n- Do not add `\\leanok` to the broader low-degree-encoding or indicator-vector\n  blueprint nodes, whose other clauses are outside this packet.\n\n### Acceptance\n\n- All five targets are complete with unchanged signatures and no prohibited\n  proof bypass.\n- `Decoding.lean` has no remaining `sorry` or `admit`.\n- `#print axioms` for all five targets has no `sorryAx`, including through #62.\n- The owned file and its direct consumers type-check; targeted and full builds\n  pass.\n- Statement-integrity and paper-gap audits confirm the restricted identity and\n  representative semantics remain intact.\n- Declaration checking, blueprint axiom checking, exact-head CI, and independent\n  review pass.\n\n---\nStage 4.3 proof packet under #47; blocked by #62 after PR #46 merges.\n",

 "body": "<!-- mipstarre-issue-key: stage43-self-dual-coordinate-identities -->\n### Motivation\n\nStage 4.3 needs the exact finite-field coordinate identities used throughout the\nPauli/Fourier algebra and later extraction argument. The statements are already\nsource-aligned; this packet proves the eleven remaining obligations in\n`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/SelfDualBasisTheorems.lean` without changing their\ninterfaces.\n\n### Target declarations\n\n1. `basisCoord_apply_eq_trace`\n2. `trace_mul_eq_dotProduct_basisCoord`\n3. `trace_basis_eq_one_of_selfDual_normal`\n4. `basisCoord_one_of_selfDual_normal`\n5. `fixedFieldModel_trace_basis_eq_one`\n6. `fixedFieldModel_basisCoord_one`\n7. `basisCoord_apply_eq_fixedBinTrace`\n8. `kappa_apply_eq_binTrace`\n9. `binTrace_mul_eq_dotProduct`\n10. `chi_mulVec_basisCoord`\n11. `fixedFieldModel_chi_mulVec_basisCoord`\n\nKeep the already-proved wrapper `chi_mulVec_kappa` unchanged and verify that it\nbecomes axiom-clean through `fixedFieldModel_chi_mulVec_basisCoord`.\n\n### Sources\n\n- Coordinate/trace identities and matrix compatibility:\n  `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:504-550`, lemma\n  `lem:downsize_field`.\n- Trace-one and all-ones-coordinate identities:\n  `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:730-767`, lemma `lem:one`.\n- Basis, coordinate-map, and multiplication-table definitions:\n  `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:433-502,669-700`.\n- Blueprint: `blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:241-311`.\n\n### Dependencies and proof order\n\nThis packet depends only on the existing `FieldBasis` and `SelfDualBasis` API.\nIt does not depend on the proofs in #65 and may run in parallel with them.\n\nFirst prove `basisCoord_apply_eq_trace` from self-duality and Mathlib's trace\nmatrix identity. Derive `trace_mul_eq_dotProduct_basisCoord` by expanding one\nfactor in the basis and using trace linearity.\n\nNext prove that trace is invariant under the binary Frobenius automorphism.\nNormality then makes the traces of all basis elements equal. Show the common\nvalue is nonzero using self-duality and basis-coordinate injectivity, conclude\nthat it is one in `ZMod 2`, and derive the fixed-model wrappers.\n\nIndependently, prove `chi_mulVec_basisCoord` by extensionality on the\n`(row, basis-coordinate)` index, splitting the product-indexed matrix sum, and\nusing basis reconstruction for each vector entry. Then obtain the fixed-model\nspecialization definitionally.\n\nFinish the `fixedBinTrace`, `binTrace`, and `kappa` spellings from the generic\ncoordinate and trace identities. A minimal finite-field Frobenius/trace import\nis permitted if not already available transitively.\n\n### Statement integrity\n\nPreserve every public signature, constant, index order, and quantifier order.\nDo not add finite-dimensionality, separability, cardinality, nonemptiness, or\nnormality hypotheses; derive required finite/free instances locally.\n\nItems 1 and 2 require self-duality. `chi_mulVec_basisCoord` deliberately does\nnot; do not add it there. Retain `hk : Odd k` on the two `lem:one` results.\nFor `chi_mulVec_basisCoord`, preserve block ordering `(matrix row, basis\ncoordinate)` and `(matrix column, basis coordinate)`.\n\nDo not use unresolved existence or `binaryCoordinates_mul` proofs as shortcuts.\nAll eleven targets and `chi_mulVec_kappa` must have no transitive `sorryAx`.\n\n### Ownership and non-goals\n\n- Own only `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/SelfDualBasisTheorems.lean`.\n- Keep support lemmas private or file-local.\n- Do not edit `SelfDualBasis.lean`, `FieldBasis.lean`, Pauli algebra, field-model\n  construction, blueprint files, or downstream observables.\n- Do not prove `exists_selfDualNormalBasis`, `exists_fixed_field_model`, or\n  `binaryCoordinates_mul`.\n\n### Acceptance\n\n- All eleven targets contain no `sorry`, `admit`, axiom, or prohibited bypass.\n- The owned file has no remaining proof holes.\n- `#print axioms` for every target and `chi_mulVec_kappa` reports no `sorryAx`.\n- The statement-integrity audit classifies the generic source results and the\n  definition-preserving fixed-model specializations explicitly.\n- The owned file passes direct Lean checking.\n- Blueprint status/axiom audits, declaration checking/rendering, the full build,\n  diff check, exact-head CI, and independent review pass.\n\n---\nStage 4.3 proof packet under #47.\n",

 "body": "<!-- mipstarre-issue-key: qpbt-stage43-canonical-coordinate-complement -->\n### Parent and objective\n\nStage 4.3 proof packet under #47. Prove that the existing intrinsic\nnonpivot-coordinate set spans a complement of every coordinate subspace input.\n\n### Source contract\n\nCanonical source: `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:303-373`, especially\n`def:canonical-complement` and `lem:canonical-complement`. Blueprint:\n`blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:86-133`.\n\nThe paper chooses nonpivot standard-basis vectors after reduced row echelon form\nand proves that their span has zero intersection with `S` and sums with `S` to\nthe ambient space. Lean's approved `canonicalComplement` encodes the same\nnonpivot set intrinsically by prefix-rank equality. The target is a faithful\ngeneralization from finite fields and `n >= 1` to any field and all `n`. It does\nnot itself prove equivalence with a particular RREF algorithm; do not add\n`\\lean` or `\\leanok` to the currently unlinked canonical-complement blueprint\nlemma in this packet.\n\n### Exact target\n\nIn `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/Subspaces.lean`, replace only the proof hole in:\n\n```lean\ntheorem isCompl_registerSubmodule_canonicalComplement {n : \u2115}\n    (W : Submodule K (Fin n \u2192 K)) :\n    IsCompl W (registerSubmodule K (canonicalComplement W)) := by\n  ...\n```\n\nPreserve the public signature and the definitions of `prefixMap`, `prefixRank`,\n`canonicalComplement`, and `canonicalProjOfKernel`. Update the stale docstring\nsentence saying the proof is deferred.\n\n### Recommended proof route\n\n1. Establish private coordinate-support facts identifying `registerSubmodule K S`\n   with the span of `Pi.single` vectors and characterize membership/support using\n   `Pi.spanSubset`, `Pi.mem_spanSubset_iff`, and `Pi.dim_spanSubset`.\n2. Rewrite `prefixRank` as the rank of `(prefixMap ...).domRestrict W`, using\n   `LinearMap.range_domRestrict` and rank-nullity.\n3. Prove the pivot criterion: equality of ranks at prefixes `j` and `j+1` iff\n   every `w \u2208 W` that vanishes below `j` also vanishes at `j`. In the strict-rank\n   case choose and normalize a vector of `W` with leading coordinate `j` equal\n   to `1`.\n4. Combine those pivot vectors with `Pi.single j 1` at nonpivot coordinates.\n   The resulting family is triangular with diagonal `1`; prove it linearly\n   independent and spanning using `Matrix.det_of_upperTriangular` and\n   `Matrix.linearIndependent_rows_of_det_ne_zero`, or an equivalent finite\n   induction.\n5. Partition pivot and nonpivot coordinates, identify the nonpivot span with\n   `registerSubmodule K (canonicalComplement W)`, and conclude `IsCompl`, for\n   example via `LinearIndependent.isCompl_span_image`. Cover `n = 0`.\n\nKeep helpers private unless independently reusable and naturally documented.\nPrefer existing Mathlib linear-algebra APIs over a new public RREF mechanism.\n\n### Ownership and non-goals\n\nOwn only `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/Subspaces.lean`. Do not edit\n`SubspacesTheorems.lean`, the blueprint, re-export files, or unrelated algebra\nmodules. Do not introduce an RREF implementation, bridge or obligation\nhypothesis, axiom, conditional theorem, or public statement change.\n\n### Dependencies and downstream\n\nThis packet has no mathematical dependency on the PR #46 diff. It removes the\ntransitive proof hole from `canonicalProjOfKernel` and unlocks the final proof\nand axiom audit of `ker_canonicalProjPerp` in the orthogonal-complement packet.\n\n### Acceptance\n\n- The exact theorem above is proved without `sorry`, `admit`, an axiom, or a\n  proof-evasion mechanism.\n- `lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/Subspaces.lean` succeeds and the owned\n  file has no proof holes.\n- Direct consumers of `canonicalProjOfKernel` type-check, followed by\n  `lake build`.\n- `#print axioms MIPStarRE.QPBT.isCompl_registerSubmodule_canonicalComplement`\n  and `#print axioms MIPStarRE.QPBT.canonicalProjOfKernel` contain no `sorryAx`.\n- The PR includes a statement-integrity audit with verdict `faithful\n  generalization under the approved basis-free prefix-rank encoding` and\n  explicitly leaves RREF equivalence out of scope.\n- Exact-head local CI and independent review pass.\n\n---\nStage 4.3 proof packet under #47.\n",

 "body": "<!-- mipstarre-issue-key: qpbt-stage43-qudit-to-qubit-isometry -->\n### Motivation\n\nComplete `lem:pauli-binary`, the qudit-to-qubit identification used by QPBT\nsoundness. The source statement is\n`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1163-1199`, with proof at lines\n1201-1262. The matched blueprint node is\n`blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:711-781`.\n\n### Target declaration\n\nProve only `MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_qubitIsometry` in\n`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/PauliTheorems.lean`, preserving its public signature\nexactly. Preserve `qubitPauliProj` and the existing `**Local fix:**` paragraph\ncorrecting the source's erroneous factor range `j in {1, ..., q}` to\n`Fin F.basisDim`, where `basisDim = log2 q`.\n\n### Dependencies and serialization\n\n- Base this packet on merged #64, which proves\n  `pauliProj_eq_avg_tauObservable`.\n- Base it on merged #66, which proves the self-dual trace and coordinate\n  identities, especially `binTrace_mul_eq_dotProduct`.\n- Start only after #68 has merged because both packets own\n  `PauliTheorems.lean`. This is a file-ownership dependency, not a mathematical\n  dependency on #68's Pauli-relation or cancellation targets.\n- The theorem receives `F : FixedFieldModel q` as data and does not depend on\n  #65's proof that such models exist.\n\n### Proof route\n\n1. Define a private label equivalence by applying\n   `F.binaryCoordinates.toEquiv` at each `Fin L` coordinate and then\n   uncurrying:\n\n   \u200b`\u200b`\u200b`lean\n   (Equiv.piCongrRight (fun _ : Fin L => F.binaryCoordinates.toEquiv)).trans\n     (Equiv.curry (Fin L) (Fin F.basisDim) (ZMod 2)).symm\n   \u200b`\u200b`\u200b`\n\n   Lift it to `phi` with `LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 C C`.\n\n2. Prove a private generic EPR transport lemma for a finite equivalence. Expand\n   `isometryTensor` and `eprState`, use\n   `EuclideanSpace.piLpCongrLeft_single`, rewrite the normalization with\n   `Fintype.card_congr`, and collapse the two permutation sums with\n   `Fintype.sum_eq_single`.\n\n3. Prove a private generic conjugation lemma identifying conjugation by the\n   inverse coordinate isometry with `Matrix.reindex` by the inverse label\n   equivalence. Collapse the two matrix-product sums explicitly. Keep the\n   orientation: `phi` maps qudit labels to bit labels, while `phi.symm`\n   realizes the paper's `phi^dagger M phi` on the qudit space.\n\n4. Establish private phase compatibility for `a,u : Fin L -> F.K` by combining\n   trace linearity, `binTrace_mul_eq_dotProduct F`,\n   `Algebra.trace_self_apply`, and `Fintype.sum_prod_type`.\n\n5. Prove entrywise transport of `tauObservable` for both `PauliKind.X` and\n   `.Z`. Use linearity and injectivity of `F.binaryCoordinates` in the shift\n   case and phase compatibility in the phase case.\n\n6. Rewrite both projectors with #64's\n   `pauliProj_eq_avg_tauObservable`, transport the finite sum along the label\n   equivalence with `Fintype.sum_equiv`, rewrite its normalization by\n   `Fintype.card_congr`, and apply observable and phase transport termwise.\n\nThe coordinate equivalence, its `piLpCongrLeft` lift, generic EPR transport,\nand generic conjugation/reindex proof have been scratch-elaborated successfully\nagainst the current imports.\n\n### Statement integrity\n\nThe paper assumes an admissible binary field size `q = 2^k`, its fixed\nself-dual normal basis, and a nonnegative tensor exponent. `FixedFieldModel q`\npackages exactly that field/basis boundary, and `L : Nat` includes the paper's\nempty tensor-power case. The two Lean conclusions are exactly the source EPR\nand `X`/`Z` projector identities. Verdict: **faithful boundary hypotheses**,\nwith the already documented source index correction; no extra assumptions and\nno weakened or strengthened conclusion.\n\n### Scope and integrity constraints\n\n- Own only the proof of `exists_qubitIsometry` and private helpers needed for\n  it in `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/PauliTheorems.lean`.\n- Do not edit `Pauli.lean`, `SelfDualBasisTheorems.lean`, blueprint files,\n  re-export files, or any other declaration in `PauliTheorems.lean`.\n- Do not replace the coordinate isometry with an arbitrary cardinality\n  equivalence; compatibility with `kappaVec F` is load-bearing.\n- Do not reverse `phi` and `phi.symm`, handle only one Pauli kind, or add a\n  positivity or nonemptiness assumption that would exclude `L = 0`.\n- Do not add public transport infrastructure, bridge assumptions, conditional\n  helpers, axioms, proof bypasses, or new proof holes.\n- Use #64 and #66 only after their proofs merge so this target has no\n  transitive `sorryAx`. No blueprint proof-status edit belongs to this\n  Lean-only packet.\n\n### Acceptance\n\n- The target `sorry` is removed and its public signature and documentation are\n  unchanged.\n- `#print axioms MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_qubitIsometry` contains no `sorryAx`.\n- After #68, `PauliTheorems.lean` contains no remaining `sorry`, `admit`, new\n  axiom, or prohibited bypass.\n- The direct file check, proof-debt scan, target build, and full build pass.\n- Declaration checking, blueprint rendering/status checks, and\n  `git diff --check` pass without a blueprint change.\n- The PR r",

 "body": "<!-- mipstarre-issue-key: qpbt-stage43-pauli-laws-cancellation -->\n### Motivation\n\nClose the first eleven proof holes in\n`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/PauliTheorems.lean`: the general-prime Pauli laws,\ntheir separately named characteristic-two corollaries, and Fourier cancellation.\nThe twelfth hole, `exists_qubitIsometry`, is explicitly excluded.\n\n### Target declarations\n\n1. `primeTauObservable_mul`\n2. `primeTauObservable_pow`\n3. `primeTauObservable_pow_char`\n4. `primeTauObservable_isUnitary`\n5. `primeTauObservable_eigenvalue_pow_char`\n6. `primeTauObservable_X_mul_Z`\n7. `tauObservable_mul`\n8. `tauObservable_sq`\n9. `tauObservable_X_mul_Z`\n10. `ffChar_dotProduct_submodule_expect_eq_zero`\n11. `avg_neg_one_pow_binTrace_eq_zero`\n\n### Sources\n\n- Generalized Pauli definitions and prime-characteristic identities:\n  `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1052-1095`.\n- Multi-qudit twisted commutation:\n  `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1141-1150`.\n- Fourier cancellation, Fact 3.2 of NW19:\n  `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1124-1132`.\n- Blueprint Pauli and cancellation nodes:\n  `blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:550-672`.\n- Characteristic-two scope record:\n  `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_characteristic-two-pauli-scope.tex`.\n\nThe blueprint links only the six `primeTauObservable_*` declarations to the\ngeneral Pauli node and `ffChar_dotProduct_submodule_expect_eq_zero` to the\ngeneral cancellation node. The four binary declarations are consumer\nspecializations and must remain unlinked to those unrestricted nodes.\n\n### Dependencies and proof order\n\nThis packet depends only on existing definitions in `Pauli.lean`,\n`FieldBasis.lean`, `Subspaces.lean`, and the proved LDT finite-field character\nAPI. It is independent of PR #46 and issues #61-#66.\n\n1. Prove private entrywise shift/phase product identities and the zero\n   observable identity; lift them through the finite product.\n2. Establish a private natural-power formula. Derive the `ZMod p` exponent\n   theorem, then prove the characteristic-`p` case separately; it is not an\n   instantiation at a `ZMod p` element whose representative is `p`.\n3. Prove the explicit adjoint/inverse identity and derive unitarity.\n4. Apply the characteristic-power result to the nonzero eigenvector and cancel\n   it to obtain the eigenvalue theorem.\n5. Prove the prime twisted relation entrywise using additivity of `ffChar`.\n6. Prove private bridges between prime and binary observables at `p = 2`, then\n   derive the three binary laws. Handle empty `\u03b9` separately for the binary\n   twisted relation, whose signature has no nonemptiness assumption.\n7. For general cancellation, view the dot-product character on `V` as an\n   additive character. A nonzero dot product can lie in the trace kernel, so\n   rescale the nonzero linear functional to obtain a value with nonzero trace\n   before applying character orthogonality.\n8. Derive binary cancellation through the characteristic-two bridge.\n\nKeep all support declarations private or file-local.\n\n### Statement integrity\n\n- Preserve the arbitrary-prime statements and canonical `ffChar`; do not narrow\n  them to characteristic two.\n- `[Nonempty \u03b9]` on the prime twisted relation faithfully represents the paper's\n  `n >= 1` condition.\n- Preserve the existing `**Scope restriction:**` markers on the four binary\n  corollaries.\n- Preserve the complex-valued uniform expectation `submoduleExpect`; do not\n  replace it with the real-valued distribution-average API.\n\n### Ownership and non-goals\n\n- Own only `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/PauliTheorems.lean`.\n- Do not change imports, definitions, public signatures, or declaration order.\n- Leave `qubitPauliProj`, `exists_qubitIsometry`, and its existing `sorry`\n  unchanged.\n- Do not prove the three holes in `Pauli.lean` or edit field-basis,\n  self-dual-basis, subspace, blueprint, gap-note, or re-export files.\n- Do not add public mechanisms, bridge assumptions, axioms, or new holes.\n\n### Acceptance\n\n- All eleven targets are complete with unchanged signatures; the only remaining\n  `sorry` in the owned file is `exists_qubitIsometry`.\n- `#print axioms` for all eleven reports no `sorryAx`.\n- Statement-integrity records the six prime laws and general cancellation as\n  faithful and the four binary results as documented specializations.\n- `PauliTheorems.lean`, `Test/QubitForm.lean`, and\n  `Observables/ExpandedDefs.lean` type-check.\n- Full build, declaration check, blueprint status/axiom audit and render, diff\n  check, exact-head CI, and independent review pass.\n\n---\nStage 4.3 proof packet under #47.\n",

 "body": "<!-- mipstarre-issue-key: stage43-direct-low-degree-geometry -->\n### Motivation\n\n- Parent: #47.\n- Depends on the structural split in #67.\n- The direct-index game already defines the repaired axis and diagonal sampling\n  laws, but its five elementary geometry statements remain admitted.\n- These statements are the direct-index counterparts of `lem:alnf` and\n  `lem:dlnf`, paper\n  `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:243-272`\n  and blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:61-85`.\n- Proving them unlocks the native-LDT adapter without restoring the invalid\n  dimension-divisibility assumption.\n\n### Targets\n\nIn `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Geometry.lean`, replace only the\nexisting proofs of:\n\n- `directALinePointDist_point_index_marginal_uniform`\n- `directALinePointDist_mem_line`\n- `directDLinePointDist_point_index_marginal_uniform`\n- `directDLinePointDist_mem_line`\n- `directDLinePointDist_prefix_zero`\n\nPreserve every declaration name, argument, result type, and docstring.\n\n### Proof order\n\n1. Add only private, file-local helpers needed for finite-distribution\n   extensionality, composition of probability-preserving pushforwards, and\n   uniform projection along an explicit finite equivalence.\n2. Exhibit `DirectLdSpace D` as both point times index/direction and index times\n   point/direction. Use those equivalences and Mathlib's uniform-PMF transport\n   and product results to prove both point/index marginal conjunctions.\n3. Prove the private fact `u \u2208 linePoints (lineRepMap v u) v`. Use\n   `Submodule.sub_projection_mem` for the canonical complementary projection,\n   then `Submodule.mem_span_singleton` to obtain the line parameter.\n4. Unpack membership in each mapped uniform support with\n   `Distribution.map_support`; apply the geometric fact to prove both incidence\n   statements.\n5. Unpack diagonal support in the same way and apply\n   `DirectLineDesc.diagonal_prefix_zero` for the prefix-zero statement.\n\nAll five proof shapes have been prototyped successfully. Do not use the\nadmitted non-direct analogues in `Test/LowDegreeGameTheorems.lean` as proof\nshortcuts.\n\n### Statement integrity\n\nThe paper samples a uniform point and a uniform axis or prefix index, with the\ndiagonal direction zero below that index. `D : DirectLdParams` supplies the\nfinite nonempty types used by the definitions. The Lean conclusions are\nexactly the uniform point/index marginals, line incidence, and diagonal\nprefix-zero property for the direct-index repair.
